cover.headline: 13 stories in 5 minutes. Democrats projected to win the House, the US strikes Qeshm island, hoax bomb threats hit European flights.

stories.head: Democrats projected to win the House
body: CNN, CBS and NBC Washington headlines say Democrats won the House and are closing in on the Senate. Talarico is projected to win in Texas.
Final totals and Senate control are not yet confirmed.

stories.head: Limited US strikes hit Qeshm island
body: US officials call the strikes defensive, after fire at a US aircraft. Iran reports blasts with no casualties and warns of a maximum deterrence plan.
Indirect talks via Qatar continue. Brent rose about 1.8% to near 106 dollars.
stories.sources: Sources: Infobae, Manila Times, Al Jazeera

stories.head: Berlin pledges winter aid; Abu Dhabi talks set
body: Merz promised a winter package. Kyiv says Russian strikes hit power plants in nine regions.
The Kremlin says US, Ukraine and Russia meet in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10 and 11.

stories.head: Bomb hoaxes hit flights; freezer hacks reach Italy
body: At least seven flights and a cruise ship were targeted. No explosives were found and nobody claimed it.
Supermarket freezer hacks now hit Sicily. Danfoss says the devices were mostly obsolete.

stories.head: Spain minister quits; ICJ judges elected; Kospi falls
body: Oscar Puente resigned after the Urda train crash that killed 69. The UN elected five ICJ judges.
Kospi fell 3.6% on an AI-chip sell-off. Australia raised rates to 4.85%. South Africa votes today.
